best-aspirant-duo-ceremony.alt: Vexana and Guinevere at the Best Aspirant Duo ceremony, new badges at their collars, with other students cheering behind them.

changes-father.alt: Chang'e's father and mother run through a burning street with Chang'e, while a giant black and gold Ender towers behind them.
Chang'e's father in a white lab coat and amber glasses stands beside a framed family photo in the lab.

emblems-of-hope.alt: On a sunny city roof, Guinevere pins a small gold star to Vexana's collar.
Guinevere stands alone in front of the white Academy building, holding her gold star up against her chest.
Falling upside down, Vexana closes her gloved hand over the gold star at her collar as light bursts around her.

guineveres-father.alt: A black silhouette of Guinevere's father in a long fur-collared coat, papers in hand, a gold question mark glowing on his chest.

hand-in-hand-photo.alt: A gloved hand holds a phone showing the photo of Guinevere and Vexana together, beside a box of keepsakes and felt dolls.

lesleys-rifle.alt: The red and gold rifle hangs in the jointed arms of a steel ring while Chang'e flings both arms out toward it.
Chang'e works at her bench with the parts of the long red and gold rifle laid out in front of her.
Lesley stands on a steel girder high above the city with her long orange rifle resting on her shoulder.

mr-bunny.alt: Mr. Bunny, the white robot with rabbit ears and a small screen face, rests on his stand beside a framed family photo.
Chang'e sits close to the camera with Mr. Bunny floating at her side, in front of a blue hologram with a crosshair.

roger.alt: Roger lies on the ground and looks up in fear as bright blades stab the ground beside him.
Roger, a thin boy with brown hair and a headset, stands between Fanny and Layla.
A close-up of Roger with blue eyes and a headset, his mouth open in alarm.

silverbolt.alt: Selena kicks one foot up on a railing, her silver dragon machine Silverbolt crackling with blue light beside her.
Silverbolt's silver dragon head with jaws open and one eye glowing blue, wreathed in blue lightning.
Selena sits on the edge of a high ledge under a storm sky, Silverbolt crouched beside her.

telescope.alt: In the glass-walled observation lab, Ruby holds a telescope while Guinevere and Angela stand beside her.
Through the round lens of the telescope, a four-pointed star of magenta light burns in the storm clouds.

cadets.alt: Two cadets in dark uniforms walk across the courtyard toward the Academy's tall white main building.

dark-ship.alt: The dark ship with a blue glow flies over the towers of Oro under a purple and orange sky.

duel-in-the-throne-hall.alt: Selena in white, blue and gold armor stands at the foot of a tall dark column as glowing red cuts split it at the base.
Selena in her gold-crested helm meets Obsidia's weapon face to face in a flash of magenta and blue light.
Close on Obsidia, her eyes wide, a thin dark cut across her cheek.

escape-from-oro.alt: A small ship trails blue light through the stars beside the glowing edge of a planet as it leaves Oro behind.

final-purge.alt: Enders crowd the dark mouth of a huge ship above a city of towers under a violet sky.

joes-lecture-on-enders.alt: Joe's last slide: the Storm Citadel, a huge ship of dark blades in a torn red sky with smaller ships swarming around it.
Design sheet of gray, clawed Enders drawn to scale beside a small human figure, one chest split open on a glowing core.

night-the-enders-came-back.alt: Chang'e on her pink crescents and Lesley with her rifle leap together at the gold and black giant over the night city.
Lesley stands in a high window at night, her long rifle across her body, the moon over the city behind the glass.

storm-night-of-983.alt: On the storm night, Obsidia looks down through the storm with a faint smile, the wind tearing at her pale hair and dark wings.
On the storm night, Obsidia holds up a clawed hand with a crackling red orb of light beside a black sun.

tree-on-the-academy-lawn.alt: In a sunlit memory under the tree on the Academy lawn, Vexana pats Guinevere's hair as Guinevere lies laughing in her lap.

corner-building.alt: Layla stands in front of the burning corner building, a towering wall of fire, her white cannon hanging from one hand.

great-door.alt: The great door: a lone figure on a broken plain among drifting stones before a vast disc of white fire ringed in red.

launch-bay.alt: In the launch bay, armored soldiers with long rifles wait by a ship's open hatch as a small prisoner is led in.
